Guidance & outlook: Standalone performance highlights for Q1 FY27, Revenue from operations for Q1 FY27 grew by 13% to INR178.8 crores as compared to INR158.7 crores in Q1 FY26.
EBITDA for quarter one FY27 grew by 21% to INR59.4 crores as compared to INR49 crores in Q1 FY26.
EBITDA margins for Q1 FY27 improved to 33.2% as compared to 30.8% in Q1 FY26.
Growth & demand: Same-store sales growth remained positive at 4.04%, highlighting strong consumer traction, improving store productivity, and the enduring strength of our brand across markets.
PAT margins for quarter one FY27 grew by 11% to INR16.3 crores as compared to INR14.7 crores in Q1 FY26.
But growth drivers for achieving the 20% growth will be the new stores and the same-store sale growth and the online category growth.
Margins & costs: During Q1, the company reported healthy revenue growth and the maintained industry-leading operating margins, reflecting disciplined cost management and scale efficiencies.
PAT margins for quarter one FY27 stood at 9.1% as compared to 9.2% in Q1 FY26.
We are looking for inflation obviously inflation has to be absorbed, that is 50, say 3% and balance is from the volume growth.
Capex & expansion: We have seen gross margin expansion both on the Y-o-Y basis and on a quarter-on-quarter basis.
My last question is that if we look at your store square feet expansion, we've seen a significant expansion of about 13%.
So we don't have much franchises in that category available who are able to do big investment in the large format stores.
Balance sheet & cash: Number one is ROCE, then it is coming back to inventory days.
Our working capital which was approximately 110, that is come down to approximately 100 days.
One is, because we have sufficient headroom to take debt and secondly, improve the visibility in terms of spending a bit more on marketing considering we have a very industry leading EBITDA margin.
Risks & challenges: There was a challenging year by the FY24 where we have seen a downside in the profit, so that has been covered back as well.
Quarter we did a little bit of dip in the quarter itself because of we are changing our software end-to-end integration, so that has taken some hit.

guidance.t: So couple of quarters it may be up and down, but overall target of maintaining the average annual margin of 60% is absolutely on track.
